user.title: Grid purchase meter
user.description: Tarifwacht books your grid purchase per quarter hour under each tariff – the dynamic one with the price of exactly that quarter hour. The comparison assumes the same consumption pattern for every tariff.

data_description.name: For example “House”. Used in entity names.
data_description.meter_entity: Energy drawn from the grid (Wh, kWh or MWh, cumulative). Best: the meter at the grid connection point.
